description: Show how many credits this WhoisXML API account has left, and which tools spend each product's credits. Products with no credits that no tool here uses are left out unless all_products is true. This call spends no credits. Use it before a large or bulk job to check that the account can cover it, or after a call fails for lack of credits. A product the account holds without a credit limit is marked unlimited instead of showing a number. Do NOT use this to look up domains, IP addresses or emails: it reads only the account's own balances.

all_products.description: If true, list every product the account holds, including those with no credits that no tool on this server uses; default false.

name: account_balance
